description:
*“My name’s Seol Daeyoung. Nice to meet you.”*

Though his mother was an Omega, the new transfer student’s build left no doubt—he looked every inch a dominant Alpha.
To survive, Jaemin had spent his whole life pretending to be an Alpha, and from the start he despised Seol Daeyoung.

*“A mutation, huh? Or should I say a defect?”*

That piercing gaze Daeyoung fixed on him was the first time Jaemin had ever felt the overwhelming force of an Alpha’s stare after realizing he was truly an Omega.

*“Not a mutation, not a defect. Seol Daeyoung.”*

Instead of an Alpha’s pheromones, Daeyoung only smelled faintly of cheap fabric softener. When Jaemin refused to shake his hand, Daeyoung simply rested it on Jaemin’s shoulder with a pat.

*“Nice to meet you, Jang Jaemin.”*

From the very day they met at eighteen—when fists flew between them—Daeyoung never missed a chance to torment Jaemin. But now, five years later, their relationship is beginning to change…

*“Why are you acting so desperate?”*

Seol Daeyoung spread Jaemin’s thighs apart as he spoke in a roughened voice.

*“Up until now, wanting to do this to me—how the hell did you hold back?”*

It felt like maybe three—no, four fingers at once were inside him. With those thick fingers working him open, Jaemin bit down on his clothes, muffling the broken moans that spilled out.

*“Feels so good you’re about to lose your mind, huh?”*

Jaemin tried to say something, but Daeyoung’s fingers filled the emptiness of his mouth instead, making it impossible.

*“I’m giving you exactly what you wanted—wrapping you around my cock. You like that, don’t you, Jaemin?”*
